en_title: Sony Patent Would Let You Tap Your Card or Phone on Your PlayStation Controller to Make a Payment
cn_title: 索尼专利拟让PlayStation手柄支持碰触支付
subtitle: 手机一碰就能付款？
opus_summary: 索尼提交了一份支持NFC的PlayStation手柄专利。用户或可将手机或信用卡贴近手柄，向主机传输支付信息，也能更方便地将账号导入新主机；但专利不保证功能会落地。

paragraphs.en: Both Sony and Microsoft have had a series of patents come out in the last week or so, and one of them would potentially bring NFC payments to the PlayStation 6.
paragraphs.cn: 过去一周左右，索尼和微软都有多项专利公开。其中一项可能让PlayStation 6支持NFC支付。

paragraphs.en: Sony filed a patent called "video game controller-driven information transfer," which describes a controller with NFC capabilities that would let you tap your phone or your credit card to your controller to send information to your console. The most obvious use for this would be for payment, but it would also let you more easily import your PlayStation account to a new console.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼提交了一份名为「由电子游戏手柄驱动的信息传输」的专利。专利描述了一款支持NFC的手柄：用户只需将手机或信用卡贴近手柄，就能向主机传输信息。最直接的用途是支付，但它也能让用户更方便地把PlayStation账号导入新主机。

paragraphs.en: Just like with any patent, there's no guarantee that this would result in an actual feature for any device, but if it did, it wouldn't be the first time this type of feature has existed. Pretty much every phone under the sun right now has similar functionality, which lets you tap your card to add it to your wallet, or tap bluetooth headphones to pair them without digging through the settings menu. So, it seems like a no-brainer to bring that functionality in some way to a console.
paragraphs.cn: 和其他专利一样，这项专利不保证会成为任何设备上的实际功能。不过，即使最终落地，这类功能也并非首创。如今几乎所有手机都有类似功能：碰触银行卡即可将其加入手机钱包，碰触蓝牙耳机即可完成配对，不必翻找设置菜单。因此，以某种形式把这项功能带到主机上，似乎是顺理成章的事。

paragraphs.en: There are of course some security issues that Sony would have to work out before implementing this, particularly if Sony wants you to import your whole account via this method. Without the right precautions, it'd be easy to grab someone's phone, tap it to your controller and effectively use their account.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，索尼在实现这项功能前还得解决一些安全问题，尤其是如果它打算让用户通过这种方式导入整个账号。缺少适当的防护措施，别人只要拿到你的手机，往手柄上一碰，实际上就能使用你的账号。

paragraphs.en: Apple gets around this when setting up a new iPhone or iPad by bringing up a cloud that you have to scan with the new device's camera that will then give permission to import the account data. It's unlikely that Sony is going to put a camera in a controller, but a more simple option would be to have your phone display a pin number that you'd have to enter into the console to get past a security check.
paragraphs.cn: 苹果在设置新iPhone或iPad时采用了另一种验证方式：屏幕上会出现一团云状图案，用户必须用新设备的摄像头扫描，才能获准导入账号数据。索尼不太可能在手柄里装摄像头，但更简单的办法是让手机显示一组PIN码，用户在主机上输入后即可通过安全验证。

paragraphs.en: What's particularly wild about this patent, though, is some of the rationale behind developing it. In the patent documentation, Sony talks about the traditional methods to input this data, like an on-screen keyboard or a QR code that you scan with your phone. But, then goes on to say "facilitating and coordinating these operations by performing multiple operational steps using multiple devices often causes performance of the video game console to suffer and/or one or more operations of the video game console to fail."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这项专利尤其让人意外的，是索尼给出的部分研发理由。专利文件提到了通过屏幕键盘输入信息、用手机扫描二维码等传统方式，随后写道：「通过多个设备执行多个操作步骤来完成并协调这些操作，往往会导致电子游戏主机性能下降，和／或导致主机的一项或多项操作失败。」

paragraphs.en: The idea here seems to be that importing all the account data through NFC will be more reliable than the current methods, and could prevent any kind of system failures during setup. NFC communication has become a lot better in recent years, to be sure, but whether it's going to make the system less prone to failure than typing in your data via a keyboard is something that'd I'd need to see to believe.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼的意思似乎是，通过NFC导入全部账号数据会比现有方式更可靠，还可能避免设置过程中出现系统故障。近些年NFC通信确实进步了不少，但要说它比用键盘输入信息更不容易出错，我得亲眼见到才信。

paragraphs.en: With all of the patents that have been coming out in the last couple weeks, it sure does seem like the next-generation consoles are actually on the way. Microsoft and Sony have both filed some pretty dystopian patents, but this one seems like it'd be genuinely useful. Either way, though, expect both the PlayStation 6 and Xbox Project Helix to be quite expensive, especially if they're announced amid the ongoing RAM crisis continues.
paragraphs.cn: 过去几周接连公开的专利，确实让人觉得次世代主机正在走来。微软和索尼都提交过一些颇有反乌托邦意味的专利，但这项看起来真能派上用场。不过，无论如何，PlayStation 6和XBOX Project Helix的价格恐怕都不会低；如果它们在当前的内存供应危机持续期间公布，情况尤其如此。
